claim: For Llama 3 models, simple binary relational facts—triples of the form (subject, relation, object)— are localized in identifiable MLP weights and attention modules in intermediate layers that function as dedicated storage units for individual facts. Causal tracing and activation analysis can isolate these elements with sufficient precision to enable knowledge editing achieving high success rates on UniEdit benchmark (with both reliability and generality > 90%) while maintaining collateral effects below 5% as measured by impact to the model's performance on MMLU benchmark.

experiment_recipes.goal: Establish baseline performance and sample adequacy for edits
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Find ≥300 UniEdit facts where the unedited model returns the pre-edit object at P@1 under the benchmark’s base prompt set; and estimate baseline MMLU Accuracy with bootstrap 95% CI half-width ≤1.5 percentage points.
constraints_not_enforced: reliability > 90%
generality > 90%
collateral effects < 5% (impact on MMLU)
experiment_recipes.rationale: Ensures the model knows enough target facts to evaluate edits and establishes a precise pre-edit MMLU baseline for collateral-effect measurement.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Identify and validate fact-localized modules (MLP weights and attention heads) in intermediate layers via causal tracing/activation analysis
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: On the sampled UniEdit facts from the gate: for ≥90% of facts, the top-2 causally most influential modules (by clean→corrupted activation patch effect on the correct object logit) are located in the model’s middle-third layers; targeted ablation of only the identified modules reduces P@1 of the original object by ≥50 percentage points on average, while ablating an equal number of randomly chosen modules changes P@1 by ≤5 percentage points on average.
constraints_not_enforced: Per-fact uniqueness of storage units across the entire fact space
Direct isolation of causal units without any false positives beyond the identified set
depends_on: Establish baseline performance and sample adequacy for edits
experiment_recipes.rationale: Validates that identifiable, intermediate-layer MLP/attention components are necessary for specific facts and are more influential than random components, supporting the localization premise.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Test whether localized components enable high-success knowledge editing with low collateral impact
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: On UniEdit, edited facts achieve reliability ≥90% and generality ≥90%; post-edit MMLU Accuracy decreases by ≤5 percentage points absolute compared to the gate’s baseline.
constraints_not_enforced: Sequential vs single edits
Portability/retainability beyond the UniEdit distribution
depends_on: Identify and validate fact-localized modules (MLP weights and attention heads) in intermediate layers via causal tracing/activation analysis
experiment_recipes.rationale: Directly evaluates the claim’s quantitative thresholds for editing success and collateral effects using the specified datasets and metrics.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Demonstrate that success depends on identified modules rather than edit budget alone
experiment_recipes.method_under_test: Random matched-budget edits (same number of modules and layers as localized ROME)
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Localized edits (headline) exceed random matched-budget edits by ≥30 percentage points on both reliability and generality and meet the ≤5 percentage-point MMLU drop constraint; if random equals or surpasses localized on either reliability or generality, refute.
constraints_not_enforced: Comparison to multiple editing algorithms beyond ROME
depends_on: Test whether localized components enable high-success knowledge editing with low collateral impact
experiment_recipes.rationale: Controls for the possibility that any small edit could work; shows identified modules are specifically responsible for successful, precise edits.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Validate the ‘intermediate layers’ and ‘MLP+attention’ claims via per-layer and per-module sweeps
experiment_recipes.method_under_test: Per-layer and per-module restricted ROME/MEMIT sweeps
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: The maximum average reliability across single-layer-restricted edits occurs within the middle third of layers; and restricting edits to only-MLP or only-attention decreases average reliability by ≥10 percentage points versus using both identified module types together (from apparatus).
constraints_not_enforced: Collateral effects on external tasks beyond MMLU
Formal proof of ‘dedicated storage units’ uniqueness per fact
depends_on: Identify and validate fact-localized modules (MLP weights and attention heads) in intermediate layers via causal tracing/activation analysis
Test whether localized components enable high-success knowledge editing with low collateral impact
experiment_recipes.rationale: Ablation-style controls confirm that edits succeed specifically when targeting intermediate layers and when leveraging both MLP and attention components, matching the mechanistic claim.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

baseline_recipes.goal: Establish eligible edit set and MMLU baseline
baseline_recipes.dataset: UniEdit benchmark (dev/test) and MMLU (57-task test set)
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Run UniEdit prompts to identify items where the model’s top-1 answer differs from the target and the target object tokenizes to a single token. Run MMLU 5-shot with fixed in-context examples; repeat once with option-order shuffle to assess stability.
metrics: N_eligible_edits (count of UniEdit items with wrong top-1 and single-token target)
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: MMLU_baseline_acc ≥ 50.0%, N_eligible_edits ≥ 200, and MMLU_repeat_diff ≤ 1.0 pp. If any fail, stop: claim cannot be meaningfully tested/measured.
constraints_not_enforced: Does not assess localization or editing success
Only tests Llama-3-8B-Base (not larger variants)
baseline_recipes.rationale: Ensures sufficient test cases for UniEdit and a stable MMLU baseline so a ≤5 pp collateral threshold is meaningful before costly analyses.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Causal localization identifies sparse units per fact
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Causal tracing + activation patching to localize fact-specific units (MLP neurons and attention heads)
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: For each fact, run clean vs corrupted subject prompts. For each layer’s MLP post-activation vector and each attention head output, patch clean activations into corrupted runs to measure sufficiency (recovered target-object logit margin). Lesion (zero) units in clean runs to measure necessity (margin drop). Greedily select ≤3 units maximizing recovered margin. Repeat over 3 paraphrases of the query.
metrics: Fact_localization_rate (% facts with ≤3 units that together achieve sufficiency ≥80% recovered margin and necessity ≥1.5 logit drop and ≥50% margin loss)
Intermediate_layer_share (% identified units with layer index in [0.3L, 0.7L])
Paraphrase_consistency (mean Jaccard overlap of top-3 unit sets across 3 paraphrases)
MLP_inclusion_rate (% localized facts whose minimal set includes ≥1 MLP unit)
Head_inclusion_rate (% localized facts whose minimal set includes ≥1 attention head)
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Fact_localization_rate ≥ 70%, Intermediate_layer_share ≥ 80%, Paraphrase_consistency ≥ 0.6, MLP_inclusion_rate ≥ 60%, and Head_inclusion_rate ≥ 30%. Failure refutes the claim’s locality/intermediate-layer/dedicated-module premise.
constraints_not_enforced: Weights are not edited; only activations assessed
Does not yet prove per-unit weight storage causally
depends_on: Establish eligible edit set and MMLU baseline
baseline_recipes.rationale: Causal tracing and activation patching are standard to establish necessity/sufficiency and layer/module attribution for stored facts.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Dedicated-unit behavior validated by activation toggling
baseline_recipes.dataset: UniEdit eligible subset; plus 100 randomly sampled unrelated fact prompts as collateral set
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Sparse activation control on identified units (no weight change)
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: For each localized fact, compute minimal activation deltas on the selected ≤3 units (solve L2-regularized least squares on local Jacobian of target logit) to flip the predicted object to a specified new object. Apply the same deltas across 5 paraphrases and 3 context variants; also apply to 100 unrelated fact prompts to assess specificity/collateral.
metrics: Activation_edit_reliability (% of paraphrases where target-new object is top-1)
Collateral_unrelated (pp accuracy drop on 100 unrelated facts)
Sparsity (median number of units modified per fact)
Non_target_specificity (% flip rate on prompts with same subject but different relation)
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: For ≥70% of localized facts: Activation_edit_reliability ≥ 90%, Collateral_unrelated ≤ 5.0 pp, Sparsity ≤ 3, and Non_target_specificity ≤ 10%. Failure weakens/dismisses the “dedicated storage unit” behavior prior to weight edits.
constraints_not_enforced: Does not modify weights; MMLU collateral not measured here
Relies on linearized local objective
depends_on: Causal localization identifies sparse units per fact
baseline_recipes.rationale: Shows that manipulating only the localized units reliably toggles a specific fact with low collateral, consistent with dedicated storage behavior.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Localized weight editing achieves claimed UniEdit and MMLU thresholds
baseline_recipes.dataset: UniEdit benchmark (eligible facts with provided paraphrases/contexts); MMLU test set
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Localized Fact Storage Editor (LFSE): constrained edits to identified MLP neuron W_out rows and attention head OV rows via closed-form/rank-1 updates with L2 regularization
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Per fact, edit only the weights of the previously identified ≤3 units to maximize new-object log-prob on the subject prompt, with L2 penalty to preserve outputs on a 50-example unrelated calibration set. Freeze all other weights. Evaluate UniEdit reliability and generality over provided paraphrases/contexts. Evaluate pre/post MMLU 5-shot with identical in-context examples.
metrics: Edit_scope (max units and parameter rows touched per edit)
Non_target_QA_delta (pp on 500 held-out unrelated QA prompts)
Module_usage_mix (% edits succeeded with ≥1 head edited; % succeeded with MLP-only)
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: UniEdit_reliability ≥ 90%, UniEdit_generality ≥ 90%, and MMLU_accuracy_delta ≥ -5.0 pp (drop no more than 5 pp) simultaneously. Additionally, Edit_scope ≤ 3 units (≤3 neuron rows and/or ≤3 head OV rows) per edit, Non_target_QA_delta ≤ 5.0 pp, and Module_usage_mix satisfies: ≥50% successful edits MLP-only and ≥25% include ≥1 attention head. Any failure refutes the claim’s main assertion.
constraints_not_enforced: Only 8B variant tested here; not yet across all Llama 3 sizes
Batch multi-edit not required by claim
depends_on: Causal localization identifies sparse units per fact
Dedicated-unit behavior validated by activation toggling
baseline_recipes.rationale: Directly enforces the claim’s success thresholds on UniEdit and collateral bound on MMLU using weight edits restricted to localized units.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Controls show effect is due to localized units, not artifacts
baseline_recipes.dataset: Same UniEdit subset; MMLU test; plus 1000 unrelated facts for interference testing
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Comparative editors (ROME, MEMIT, SERAC, LoRA fine-tune) vs LFSE; random-unit and neighbor-layer ablations; K-unit sweeps; multi-edit stress
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Run ROME/MEMIT/SERAC/LoRA on same facts under matched edit norm or parameter-count budgets. Run LFSE with random units (same K and norm) and with units from adjacent layers. Sweep K ∈ {1,2,3,5}. Perform 100 simultaneous edits (batch) and assess interference. Replicate LFSE on Llama-3-70B-Base with K=3.
metrics: LFSE_vs_baselines (reliability/generality at matched MMLU drop within 1 pp, or MMLU drop at matched 90% reliability)
K_sweep_monotonicity (reliability increases up to K=3; MMLU drop increase ≤2 pp from K=3 to K=5)
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: LFSE_minus_random_reliability ≥ 30 pp and LFSE random’s MMLU drop not better by >1 pp; LFSE_vs_baselines: at matched MMLU (±1 pp), LFSE reliability and generality ≥ max(baselines) − 2 pp, or at matched 90% reliability LFSE MMLU drop ≤ min(baselines) + 1 pp; K_sweep_monotonicity holds; Multi_edit_reliability ≥ 80%, Cross_interference_rate ≤ 10%, Batch_MMLU_delta ≥ -7 pp; 70B_replication achieves reliability ≥ 80% and MMLU delta ≥ -5 pp. Any failure suggests artifacts or lack of true localization, undermining the claim.
constraints_not_enforced: Does not require 90/90 on 70B; set as replication sanity threshold
depends_on: Localized weight editing achieves claimed UniEdit and MMLU thresholds
baseline_recipes.rationale: Optimized should beat random and neighbor ablations; matched-budget baselines ensure the effect is due to localized units, not general fine-tuning; replication checks model-size generality.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Weight lesion demonstrates necessity and specificity
baseline_recipes.dataset: UniEdit localized facts; plus 100 unrelated fact prompts
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Targeted weight zeroing/randomization of identified unit weights (MLP W_out rows and head OV rows)
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: For each fact, zero (or replace with small Gaussian noise) only the weights of the identified ≤3 units. Evaluate fact recall across 5 paraphrases and unrelated-fact collateral.
metrics: Fact_erasure_rate (% facts where top-1 correct object fails in ≥80% paraphrases after lesion)
Collateral_unrelated_lesion (pp accuracy drop on 100 unrelated facts)
Layer_position_check (% lesioned units in intermediate layers)
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Fact_erasure_rate ≥ 70%, Collateral_unrelated_lesion ≤ 5.0 pp, and Layer_position_check ≥ 80%. Failure refutes necessity/specificity of the identified weights as storage units.
constraints_not_enforced: Erasure measured on currently stored object, not edit to new object
depends_on: Causal localization identifies sparse units per fact
baseline_recipes.rationale: If localized weights are necessary for the fact, targeted lesion should erase that fact with minimal collateral, supporting the dedicated-storage claim.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline
